why: No major reviewer or tested guide answers this. The two famous names are a deal roundup and launch news. Blink's support pages are authoritative but only say the official mount does not fit the Outdoor 4, leaving the shopper with nothing to buy; the Best Buy answer contradicts them. A page that resolves the compatibility confusion and compares standalone third-party panels with current prices would be the best source here.
